capabilities: Search movies and TV series via TMDB from the command palette
Generate templated Markdown watch records with posters, ratings, and synopsis
Track TV series by season with episode lists and watch progress
Browse all watch records in a card wall view
Fill in personal fields such as thoughts, rating, platform, and watch status
extras: Desktop only; the README states mobile has not been tested and is not supported. Default metadata language is Simplified Chinese. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record a movie and TV watching history with automatically fetched metadata like posters, ratings, and synopses.

relations.evidence: Fetches media information via TMDB API, generates structured watch records

summary: Media logging plugin that searches TMDB for movies and TV series, generates templated watch-record notes, and shows them in a card wall view.
